status: declared before the round-3 campaigns (Reviewer 2 tasks R2B-01 to R2B-06)

aperture_model.source: Only the exit-septum blade distance (1.478 mm, +x side) follows the companion NKM geometry; all other dimensions are declared assumptions.

steering.response: error-free model line of each design, finite-difference kicks 1e-5 rad

errors.static: independent Gaussian: gradient 0.1 %, x/y offsets 100 um, rolls 0.5 mrad, dipole fields 0.05 % (round-2 levels)
errors.shot: entrance beta factors 5 %, x 0.5 mm, x' 0.2 mrad, centroid momentum 0.1 % (round-2 levels)

robust_design.objective: minimize log10 of the largest shot-averaged Gaussian loss probability over all apertures (beam plus linearly transported entrance jitter), error-free line
robust_design.constraints: six exit-match equalities (round-2 scales) and horizontal peak beta <= 60 m on 16 subdivisions; round-2 K bounds
robust_design.starts: reference, refined low beta and the 349-solution multistart pool member of lowest objective

sensitivity.observable: analytic Gaussian loss and five-sigma clearance only (no particle tracking)

loss_estimate: per shot: largest single-aperture Gaussian loss probability (lower bound) and union bound (upper); validated against tracked losses

multistart.solver: bounded least squares on the scaled exit residuals, tolerance 1e-4

scope: Parametric apertures except the companion-derived blade; independent Gaussian errors; no ring capture.
